subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is source-level terminal proof plus regression coverage sufficient for this classifier-only delivery-path fix, or should the PR wait for live WhatsApp/OpenRouter transport proof?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but it changes the terminal message-delivery classifier and the original report came from a live channel run that was not rerun in this review.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
